description: A toy kitchen set is in front, with a tall gray fridge next to an oven, and food items visible inside on two shelves. The left hand reaches forward to pull the fridge door open and holds it there, while the right hand reaches into the lower shelf to pick out a red fruit and then a banana and green fruit, setting them down on the countertop; the right hand then grabs a bread roll and finally reaches up to take the hamburger from the upper shelf and places it with the other items, after which the left hand swings the fridge door closed.
